item.isekai_mahou.abyss_shard.desc: Torn from the depths. 8 around a Mana Crystal form an Abyss Core.
item.isekai_mahou.abyss_core.desc: Use: refills mana and ultimate charge (2 min cooldown).
item.isekai_mahou.shadow_fragment.desc: Remains of a defeated Shadow. Use: Shadow Veil for 3 min (strength, speed and night vision).
screen.isekai_mahou.endless_abyss.title: Endless Abyss
screen.isekai_mahou.endless_abyss.desc: Endless floors, each harder than the last. A boss every 5; a rare prize and a new starting point every 10. Falling does not kill you: you return to where you were.
screen.isekai_mahou.endless_abyss.shadow: Face the dark version of the bosses you have already defeated.
No Shadows yet. Defeat a boss in the world and its Shadow will appear here.
